name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_connect_edit_kill_focus
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::OnConnectStringEditKillFocus commits the connect-string edit for the selected profile and clears that profile mode when the text differs from the saved connect string.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Reconstructed remains limited because Binary Ninja cannot fully lift the inlined strcmp sbb sequence at 0x44215b; the disassembly and current function comment document the source behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x442100 validates a thiscall void handler that calls CWnd::GetWindowTextA(CString&) on m_connectStringEdit into m_profileConnectStrings[m_selectedProfileIndex], compares against m_savedConnectStrings[m_selectedProfileIndex] with an inlined strcmp loop, and writes 0 to m_profileConnectStringModes[m_selectedProfileIndex] only when the strings differ.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_connect_edit_kill_focus_smoke patches imported MFC42 CWnd::GetWindowTextA(CString&) and verifies both equal-text preservation of the existing profile mode and changed-text clearing of the selected profile mode.
